images.title: How agent evaluation moved from test cases to traces and back
images.alt: Three stages. Known signals: structured RAG test cases. Discovering failures: free-form agent traces from early agents. Structuring recurring failures: today, agent test cases built from trace evidence.

images.title: A simulated conversation with a coding agent and the GitHub MCP server
images.alt: A simulated user asks the coding agent to fix issue 184 about duplicate webhooks. The agent fetches the issue from the GitHub MCP server, edits the handler, runs the tests and reports that they pass. The user asks for a pull request linked to the issue; the agent opens PR 212 through the MCP server and confirms.
